name: barbell heaving snatch balance
description: A snatch drill where you dip, drive and drop under a bar on your back into an overhead squat. It builds speed and overhead stability.
instructions: Rest the bar on your upper back and take a wide snatch grip.
Dip and drive up explosively, pushing the bar off your shoulders.
Drop quickly into a squat while pressing the bar overhead.
Catch it with locked arms over your mid-foot.
Stand up with control and return the bar to your back.
